title: Palau
summary: Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island nation. It is in the Pacific Ocean.

paragraphs: Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island nation. It is in the Pacific Ocean. Palau is 300 miles (500 km) east of the Philippines. It got independence from United Nations trusteeship administration (administered by the United States of America) in 1994. It is one of the world's youngest and smallest nations. It is sometimes referred to in English under its native name Belau. The capitol of Palau used to be Koror. It is now located in Melekeok State.

sections.heading: Climate
paragraphs: Palau has a tropical climate all year round. Average yearly temperature is around 82 °F (27 °C).
